Taaki Allah unhein unke behtareen kaamon ka badla de aur apne fazl se unhein aur zyada de.
Unhein unke sabar ke badle jannat ke buland mehal diye jayenge aur wahan unka taqdeem aur salam se istiqbal kiya jayega.
Aur mujhe niamaton wali jannat ke warison mein shamil kar.
Jo koi achi neki le kar aayega uske liye usse behtar badla hoga aur wo us din ke khauf se aman mein honge.
Aur jo kuch tumhein diya gaya hai wo duniyawi zindagi ka samaan aur uski zeenat hai, aur jo Allah ke paas hai wo behtar aur baki rehne wala hai.
Kya unke liye yeh kafi nahi ki humne tum par kitab utari jo un par padhi jati hai?
Aur iman walon ki madad karna hum par haq tha.
Aur jo apna aap Allah ke supurd kar de aur wo nek-okaar bhi ho to usne mazboot rassi pakad li.
Hamari aayat par sirf wo log iman laate hain ke jab unhein unse naseehat ki jati hai to wo sajde mein gir padte hain aur apne Rab ki tareef karte hain.
Wohi hai jo tum par rehmat bhejta hai aur uske farishte bhi taaki tumhein andheron se nikal kar noor ki taraf le jaye.
Keh do beshak mera Rab apne bandon mein se jise chahte hai rozi kushada karta hai aur jise chahte hai tang karta hai, aur jo kuch tum kharch karte ho wo uska badla deta hai.
Aur wo kehange tamaam taareefen Allah ke liye hain jisne humse gham door kar diya, beshak hamara Rab bohot bakhshne wala aur qadr-daan hai.
Kya main ne tumse ahd nahi liya tha ai aadam ki aulad ki shaitan ki ibadat mat karna, beshak wo tumhara khula dushman hai?
Aur humne aasman aur zameen ko aur jo kuch unke beech hai be-faida paida nahi kiya.
Beshak humne logon ke liye tum par s सच्चाई ke saath kitab utari hai, pas jo hidayat ikhtiyar karega wo apne hi faide ke liye karega.
Pas sabar karo, beshak Allah ka wada sachha hai aur apne gunah ki bakhshish maango aur subah wa shaam apne Rab ki tareef ke saath tasbeeh karo.
Jisne nek amal kiya wo apne hi faide ke liye kiya aur jisne burai ki uska bojh usi par hai, aur tumhara Rab bandon par zulm karne wala nahi hai.
Allah apne bandon par bohot narm hai, wo jise chahta hai rozi deta hai aur wo quwwat wala aur ghalib hai.
Dakhil ho jao jannat mein tum aur tumhari biwiyan khush kiye jaoge.
Beshak faisle ka din un sabka tayyar waqt hai.
Jisne nek amal kiya wo apne liye kiya aur jisne burai ki wo usi par hai, phir tum apne Rab ki taraf lautaye jaoge.
Aaj tumhein zillat ka azab diya jayega us wajah se ki tum zameen mein na-haq takabbur karte the.
Pas jaan lo ki Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahi aur apne gunah ki bakhshish maango aur momin mardon aur momin aurton ke liye bhi.
Yaqeenan Allah mominon se raazi ho gaya jab wo darakht ke neeche tumse bai'at kar rahe the.
Aur agar mominon ke do giroh aapas mein ladaein to unke beech sulah karao.
Hum behtar jaante hain jo wo kehte hain aur tum un par koi zabardasti karne wale nahi ho, pas Quran se naseehat karo us shakhs ko jo mere waid se dare.
Pas Allah ki taraf bhago, beshak main tumare liye uski taraf se khula darane wala hoon.
Aur Allah hi ka hai jo kuch aasmanon mein hai aur jo kuch zameen mein hai taaki wo un logon ko unke kaamon ka badla de jinhone burai ki aur unhein accha badla de jinhone neki ki.
Sachi izzat ki jagah mein bohot qudrat wale badshah ke paas.
Zameen par jo koi hai sab fana hone wala hai.
Aur sirf tumhare Rab ki azeem aur izzat wali zaat hi baki rahegi.
Aur aage badhne wale to aage hi badhne wale hain.
Wohi Allah ke sabse qareeb log hain.
Kaun hai jo Allah ko achha qarz de taaki wo use uske liye guna kar de aur uske liye ba-izzat ajar ho?
Wo Allah hi hai jiske siwa koi mabood nahi, wo ghaib aur hazir ka jaane wala hai, wo reham karne wala aur meherban hai.
Ai iman walon, Allah ke madadgaar ban jao.
Keh do jo kuch Allah ke paas hai wo khel-tamashay aur tijarat se kahin behtar hai aur Allah sabse behtar rozi dene wala hai.
Kushada haal ko apni kushadgi ke mutabiq kharch karna chahiye aur jiski rozi tang ho wo usme se kharch kare jo Allah ne use diya hai.
Rabbi-bni li 'indaka baitan fil-jannati—Ai mere Rab mere liye apne paas jannat mein ek ghar bana.
Wohi hai jisne tumhare liye zameen ko taabi kar diya pas uske raston mein chalo aur uski rozi mein se khao.
Pas apne Rab ke hukum ke liye sabar karo aur machli wale ki tarah na ho jao jab usne gham mein bhar kar pukara tha.
Aur jo apni namazon ki hifazat karte hain.
Wohi jannaton mein izzat paane wale honge.
Rabbi-ghfir li wa li-walidayya wa liman dakhala baitiya mu'minan—Ai mere Rab mujhe bakhsh de aur mere waldain ko aur jo iman wale ho kar mere ghar mein dakhil ho.
Har jaan apne kaamon ke badle mein rehne wali hai.
Beshak yeh tumhara badla hai aur tumhari koshish ki qadr ki gayi hai.
Aur is jannat ki niamaton ke liye to aage badhne walon ko ek doosre se aage badhna chahiye.
Aur jab un par Quran padha jata hai to sajda kyun nahi karte?
Beshak jo log iman laye aur unhone nek amal kiye unke liye aisi jannatein hain jin ke neeche nehre behti hain, yeh bohot badi kamyabi hai.
Wohi log daahine haath wale hain.
Kya usne tumhein yateem pa kar thikana nahi diya?
Aur usne tumhein rasta bhatka hua pa kar hidayat di.
Aur usne tumhein mohtaj pa kar ghani kar diya.
